name: Caledone
source: Being appointed as the next king's advisor at such young age spoke much about his ingenuity and talent. Since young age, Caledone was never the center of his parents because of his older sister. Instead of agonizing over it, he utilized this as the chance to grow and found his passion in magic and history.
